events.summary: Super Micro Computer announced the NVIDIA Vera CPU rack, a 256-CPU, 100% liquid-cooled rack-scale solution complementing the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform for agentic AI workloads; the release also notes that the complementary NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 rack is now shipping. No financial terms, orders, or customer commitments were disclosed.
